visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with vibrant green-dyed hair and a white bathrobe stands in a minimalist, bright white studio setting. She holds a small grey remote control. Large white text overlays identify the brand "PAULA'S CHOICE" and the collaborator "丹妮婊姐". (2) Close-up shots transition quickly, showing the woman's face from various angles. She smiles broadly, revealing white teeth, and touches her cheeks with manicured hands. The lighting is high-key studio style, casting very soft shadows and emphasizing clear skin texture. (3) The woman holds a purple skincare bottle. A macro close-up reveals the label "0.3% Retinol + 2% Bakuchiol". She points to the text on the bottle and then demonstrates the application by lightly dabbing her forehead and nasolabial folds with her fingers. (4) She presents a purple tube of body lotion. A close-up shows her squeezing a white cream onto her forearm. She rubs the lotion into her skin with smooth, circular motions. Her facial expression is one of satisfaction and pleasure during the demonstration. (5) The scene shifts to the woman lying on a white bed with plush pillows, looking directly at the lens. A rapid-fire montage of previous shots flashes by, followed by a final teal screen with white brand logos and a search bar graphic.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: PAULA'S CHOICE SKINCARE X 丹妮婊姐. (2) [Variety]: 在保養上遇到的困難? [Subtitle]: 很多耶 因為我已經四十歲了. (3) [Variety]: 最近用過最有感的護膚品. [Subtitle]: 寶拉的0.3%A醇抗老黃金比例. (4) [Subtitle]: 你臉上那種細線那種抬頭紋 或是法令紋那種淺淺的 我跟你講你用上去一陣子之後 你可以鏗鏘有力看到 它們真的不見變平了. (5) [Variety]: 日常保養中，最不能少的儀式感? [Subtitle]: 我覺得就是全身耶 因為很多女生就只顧到臉 這怎麼可以呢 身上這樣粗粗的. (6) [Subtitle]: 這是我推薦過非常多次的 寶拉2%水楊酸身體乳. (7) [Subtitle]: 認真擦 真的宛如嬰兒的皮膚. (8) [Variety]: 無濾鏡肌膚有自信嗎? [Subtitle]: Of course! 用寶拉就是素顏上鏡都OK啊! (9) [Logo]: PAULA'S CHOICE SKINCARE. [Slogan]: 寶拉珍選.
